import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getFirstRechargeClaimData } from '@src/response-apps/recharge/firstRechargeClaim/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 礼包奖励领取指令
 * 领取指定档位的礼包奖励
 * 指令格式：/领取礼包奖励 1 或 /领取礼包奖励 6 或 /领取礼包奖励 30
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  try {
    const result = await getFirstRechargeClaimData(uid, String(bid ?? ''), e.MessageText, createBackendRequestContext(e));
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    switch (result.code) {
      case 'NO_MATCH':
        md.addText('请指定要领取的档位金额，例如：领取礼包奖励 1');
        break;
      case 'INVALID_TIER':
        md.addText(`无效的档位金额，有效档位：${result.validTiers.join('、')}元`);
        break;
      case 'FAILED': {
        const failMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, '领取礼包奖励', result.error, createBackendRequestContext(e));

        md.addText(failMsg);
        break;
      }
      case 'SUCCESS':
        md.addBold('【礼包奖励】');
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`解锁${result.tierYuan}元档奖励！`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`获得：${result.rewardText}`);
        break;
    }

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('领取礼包奖励失败:', error);

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('领取失败，请稍后再试。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});
